name: generate_image
description: Generate one image from a text prompt using the connected AI Image Model. Use whenever the user asks for a new picture, wallpaper, illustration or logo. Saves the file under X5Agent/Data/files/images and returns its name so it renders as a professional centered card at the end of the chat with fullscreen zoom. Keep prompts concrete (subject + style + mood, max 1000 chars).

prompt.description: What to draw (subject + style + mood, max 1000 chars).
